notes: REF-BM-02: no favicon collection anywhere (schema/types/parseMetadata only capture title/description/image). REF-BM-03: only title is editable pre/post-save; description (previewDescription) has no edit field at all. REF-BM-04: UpdateBookmarkInput omits url and description, so only title/note/tags are editable. REF-BM-06: backend detects duplicate normalized_url and warns, but the UI's 'Save anyway' just force-creates a second bookmark with the same url (allowDuplicate bypasses the check) instead of routing the user to edit the existing one — violates the 'prevents duplicates' rule. REF-BM-07: list cards show title/description/tags but never a favicon (no favicon field exists). REF-BM-12: bookmarks_fts indexes only title/url/note — preview_description is never inserted into the FTS index, so description text isn't searched. REF-BM-10: no autocomplete/datalist/suggestion UI for tag entry, just free text. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' inline search syntax; tag filtering is only a separate query param/UI chip. REF-BM-15: search builder (toMatchExpr) ANDs every whitespace token as its own prefix phrase — no OR/NOT/parentheses grammar and no special quoting rule for literal operators. REF-BM-16: user-typed quotes aren't parsed as phrase groups; every token is independently re-quoted with a prefix wildcard, so exact multi-word phrase search isn't supported. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view anywhere in schema, API, or UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints. REF-BM-22: list is hardcoded to created_at DESC with no sort key exposed. REF-BM-23: notes can be written and are shown, but no markdown parser/renderer is used (plain text with an emoji prefix). REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot capture (local HTML/PDF) or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag, archive endpoint, or archive view exists. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity/table/endpoint for saved search+tag filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export code path. REF-BM-32: no settings entity or UI for sort/items-per-page/font-size preferences.
